sql: SELECT y.trip_date, y.trips, w.prcp_mm, CASE WHEN h.holiday_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'federal_holiday' ELSE 'non_holiday' END AS holiday_status FROM whybot.yellow_daily y LEFT JOIN whybot.nyc_weather_daily w ON w.obs_date = y.trip_date LEFT JOIN whybot.us_holidays h ON h.holiday_date = y.trip_date WHERE y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-04-01' AND DATE '2025-02-28' AND w.prcp_mm > 20 AND h.holiday_date IS NULL AND (SELECT d_dow FROM TPCDS_DB.date_dim WHERE d_date = y.trip_date) = 4 ORDER BY y.trip_date LIMIT 50
